mechanism: Phenobarbital is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that increases hepatic metabolism of albendazole and its active metabolite albendazole sulfoxide, reducing their plasma concentrations and antiparasitic efficacy.
action: Monitor clinical response to albendazole therapy closely; consider increasing albendazole dose or selecting alternative antiparasitic agents not affected by CYP450 induction; avoid concurrent use if possible.
